intro.text: Common spren that appear around frightened people, as small violet globs that crawl out of the ground and gather at their feet.

description.text: They go to whoever is most afraid; people who are less afraid do not draw them.
Listeners see them as long purple worms, probably because they see the whole antenna rather than just its tip.
In Shadesmar they are large, eel-like creatures with stumpy legs, ridged backs and long, globby purple antennae. The antennae are the part seen in the Physical Realm.
